intro: White Oak, Oak, and Seasoned Hardwoods are the same price. Hickory is priced slightly higher due to limited availability, so call for current Hickory pricing. Price varies by quantity. Delivery and stacking included.

tiers.name: The Weekender
tiers.description: 2 ft long × 2 ft tall. Enough wood for a weekend stay, Friday and Saturday night. Available only in the Highlands-Cashiers area.

tiers.name: Quarter Cord
tiers.description: Our smallest stacked delivery, 4 ft long × 4 ft tall. Perfect for the occasional fire or a one-time use.

tiers.name: Face Cord
tiers.description: One row of wood stacked 8 ft long × 4 ft tall. Ideal for the occasional user through the season.

tiers.name: Half Cord
tiers.description: Two rows stacked 8 ft long × 4 ft tall. Ideal size for a typical residential season.

tiers.name: Full Cord
tiers.description: Four rows of wood stacked 8 ft long × 4 ft tall. Best value for heavier home use.

tiers.name: Commercial / Bulk
tiers.description: Custom quantities for restaurants, brick pizza ovens, BBQ kitchens, hotels, and resorts.
